title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Tunnel Metadata Work Item
summary: Add request and accepted-response metadata extension points for RFC 9220 WebSocket tunnel helpers.
planned_changes:
- Add an `Http3Client.OpenWebSocketAsync` overload that accepts additional non-pseudo request headers.
- Add `Http3ServerOptions.WebSocketAcceptResponseHeadersSelector` for accepted tunnel response headers.
- Add local HTTP/3 QUIC loopback tests for subprotocol-style metadata and additional pseudo-header rejection.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 WebSocket metadata tests, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Production proxy target, timeout, or authorization policy.
completion_notes: The HTTP/3 WebSocket helpers now carry application request metadata and accepted-response metadata while keeping Extended CONNECT pseudo-fields framework-owned.
